observations.contents: 91C2: Gmail send-confirmation card. Header row shows colorful Gmail 'M' icon + 'Gmail' label, plus an X close button top-right. Headline: 'Send this message?'. Fields: 'To: hello@voiceos.com', 'Subject: Meeting tomorrow', then 'Message Preview: Hey team, just wanted to follow up on our meeting tomorrow...' (truncated with ellipsis, dimmer text color). No source/provenance line of any kind. Buttons: filled blue 'Send' (primary) and outlined 'Edit' (secondary), stacked vertically on the right; no explicitly labeled Cancel button (only the X icon serves that role). || E7D5: Slack send-confirmation card (Japanese UI). Header row shows '# Slack' in purple. Headline: 'このメッセージを送りますか?' (Send this message?). Below it a small orange warning line with an icon: '外部に出る' (going external / leaves the org). Fields with dim gray labels and bold white values: '宛先 #sales' (To) and '差出人 あなた' (From: You). Then a full preview sentence of the message body: '明日の会議、資料を先に共有します。10月の導入時期の件も入れておきました。' (not obviously truncated, ends on a full stop). Below that a provenance line: '出所 週次同期・田中・10:42 >' (Source: weekly sync, Tanaka, 10:42, with a '>' suggesting it expands/links to more detail). Buttons at bottom right: plain-text 'Cancel', text-styled blue 'Edit', and a filled orange/yellow '送る' (Send) primary button.
observations.sizes: Raw file dimensions: 91C2.png is 500x200px (~100,000 px^2); E7D5.png is 560x229px (~128,240 px^2), so E7D5's image is roughly 28% larger in area. Cannot tell whether these crops reflect true relative on-screen scale in each product (e.g. actual window/notification size, DPI, or capture zoom) — treating this only as what is directly measurable from the provided files.

why.action_clarity: Both lead with an unambiguous yes/no question ('Send this message?' / 'このメッセージを送りますか?') at the same visual weight, so neither is clearer than the other.
why.parameter_hierarchy: E7D5 gives each field a dim gray label next to a bold white value (宛先/差出人), making label vs. value instantly scannable; 91C2's 'To:'/'Subject:' labels and values share the same weight, so the field name and its content blur together.
why.preview_readability: E7D5's message preview is full-weight white text and reads as a complete sentence; 91C2's preview is rendered in a dimmer gray and is visibly truncated with an ellipsis, which is harder to read and leaves the content incomplete.
why.control_visibility: E7D5 has three explicitly labeled actions (Cancel / Edit / 送る) so the negative action is a real, discoverable button; 91C2 only offers Send and Edit, relying on a small corner X for cancellation, which is less visible and less obviously a 'decline' control.
why.screen_occupation: Based on the supplied file dimensions, E7D5 (560x229) covers more pixel area than 91C2 (500x200); true on-screen scale in the live product cannot be confirmed from these crops alone.
why.visual_craft: 91C2 reads as a more finished elevated card: rounded corners, a gradient dark surface, a colorful brand icon, generous padding, and two clearly-chromed buttons (filled + outlined); E7D5 packs in more rows with tighter spacing and its Cancel/Edit controls are plain text rather than styled buttons, giving it a flatter, less polished feel despite the added information.
why.error_prevention: E7D5 surfaces an explicit warning ('外部に出る' — this goes external) above the fields and a clearly labeled Cancel button, both of which push back against an accidental send; 91C2 has no warning of any kind and no labeled decline action.
why.provenance_visibility: E7D5 has a dedicated '出所' (source) line naming the trigger, person, and time ('週次同期・田中・10:42') with an affordance to see more; 91C2 shows no information at all about what generated the draft or why.
